headlines.description: — Led by CJ McCollum's 23 points, the Atlanta Hawks used a 17-0 run in the second half to take the lead and beat the Indiana Pacers 132-116 on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: CJ McCollum scores 23 points and Hawks ride 17-0 second-half run to charge past Pacers 132-116

headlines.description: — Brandon Miller scored 30 points, and the Charlotte Hornets took a 50-point lead for the second time this month on the way to rolling past the Philadelphia 76ers 130-93 on Monday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hornets take a 50-point lead for 2nd time this month, roll past 76ers 130-93

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 45 points and the Cleveland Cavaliers beat the Orlando Magic 114-98 on Monday night for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell scores 45 as Cavaliers beat Magic 114-98 for 4th straight win

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Boston Celtics

headlines.description: — Payton Pritchard scored 23 points, hitting buzzer-beaters to end each of the first two quarters, and Jaylen Brown added 20 on Monday night to lead the Boston Celtics to a 102-94 victory over the Portland Trail Blazers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pritchard scores 23, Brown has 20 as Celtics beat Trail Blazers 102-94

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Chicago Bulls

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 46 points, 11 assists and seven rebounds, and the Los Angeles Lakers cooled off the Chicago Bulls with a 129-118 victory on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic scores 46 points as the Lakers beat the Bulls 129-118

headlines.description: — Alperen Sengun and Kevin Durant each scored 33 points as the Houston Rockets broke open a close game in the fourth quarter and beat the Memphis Grizzlies 108-99 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sengun and Durant score 33 apiece as Rockets beat the Grizzlies 108-99

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Rudy Gobert had 15 points and 17 rebounds as the Minnesota Timberwolves defeated the Golden State Warriors 108-83 on Monday night in a game missing much of its usual star power.
headlines.shortLinkText: Timberwolves beat the Warriors 108-83 to snap a five-game losing streak as top stars rest
